items.rationale: A hard number on agentic ad ops: 17.5% of 36,289 Meta ad batches through Ads Uploader came from AI agents - roughly one in six uploads is no longer typed by a person.
items.excerpt: By arithmetic on vendor data, about 6,350 agent batches reached Meta in 30 days, about 212 a day. Will agents built by Amazon, Meta and X take over that share?

items.rationale: Agentic media buying reaches streaming TV: custom buying agents combine NBCU/FreeWheel identity data with Dentsu and Newton audience intelligence to recommend NBCU inventory.
items.excerpt: Custom buying agents pair identity data from NBCU and FreeWheel with audience intelligence from Dentsu and Newton to recommend NBCU ad inventory — agentic media buying comes to streaming TV.

items.rationale: Actionable for merchants tomorrow: Google Merchant Center rolls out a US hub to onboard to the Universal Commerce Protocol, the plumbing that lets AI agents check out on a seller's behalf.
items.excerpt: Google Merchant Center is rolling out the UCP integration hub in the United States. The UCP integration hub allows you to onboard to UCP program from your Merchant Center account.

items.rationale: A brand moves its point of sale into the assistant: Radisson and Accenture ship a ChatGPT app that lets travelers find, compare and book hotels inside the conversation.
items.excerpt: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

items.rationale: First third-party fraud read on ChatGPT ads: TrafficGuard flags up to 34% invalid clicks for some advertisers, with four hosting/proxy networks driving 47% of flagged clicks - a measurement check every buyer of the new surface needs.
items.excerpt: Four hosting and proxy networks reached 25 of 47 advertisers and drove 47% of flagged clicks. Vendor-sourced figures leave open what advertisers were billed.
